utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can bring a screwdriver and maybe some spare screws if I can find them. I’m a bit behind on the details, so I’m glad you’re keeping track.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let you know as soon as I confirm the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — appreciate it. Just keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve got the bulbs covered, so what else do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Mara—I’ll note the bulbs as covered. If you can help with anything else, I’ll keep track of where it’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure—point me to the next gap, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Happy to help—who should I check in with first about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Start with Cleo—she’s keeping track of supplies. Then just let me know what we’re short on and I’ll help fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it—I’ll check in with Cleo about the supplies and report back on what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still waiting on the latest repair-drive details, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I hear. If you’ve got anything to label or sort, go ahead and mark it for now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira—I'll label and sort what I can for now. Just let me know the drop-off time when you hear it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m waiting on the latest, and I’ll let you know the drop-off time as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Kira—if you can bring any spare tape, screws, or a screwdriver, that’d help a lot. I’ll keep track of what we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll bring some tape, screws, and a screwdriver. We’re still on for around 3, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, 3 works for me — and thanks, Kira, that’ll cover a lot. I’ll keep track and let you know if we still need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — that’ll help a lot. If Manny shows up with the pickup, we should be in good shape for the heavy pieces.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, if Manny’s got the pickup, I can handle the tools and smaller fixes. Just point me where you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Gus — I’ll steer you toward the smaller fixes once we get set up. Manny’s pickup should make the heavy stuff a lot easier.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Morning works best for me too—9 should be fine. I’ll be there to help with the setup around school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, 9 works for me too. I’m bringing a box of working light bulbs, so no need to label them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Sam — I’ll plan on the 9 a.m. setup and keep the light bulbs unlabelled.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll be there at 9, like we planned. Let’s keep it simple and get the bigger items loaded first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: 9 is too early for me — I was thinking around 3, and I still need the exact drop-off time plus a quick list of what’s left to move. If you can bring the tape and spare screws, I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 3 works for me. I’ll bring the tape and spare screws—just send me the exact drop-off time and the short list of what’s left to move.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m happy to help out, even if I might need a reminder or two about the details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still waiting on the details, but I can keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Uli — I appreciate that. I’ll try to get the details sorted and let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 3 works for me — I’ll bring the tape and spare screws. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll check my toolbox and bring a screwdriver if I’ve got one. See you at 3!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Perfect, thanks—see you at 3.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let’s start with the broken fence by the community center, then we can tackle the loose benches after that. If you’re coming, 9 AM is the meetup and gloves plus a screwdriver would really help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll be there at 9 with gloves and a screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m bringing a labeled box of light bulbs for the repair drive. Anything else you still need fixed?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Mina — thank you. We still need a few odds and ends, but everything’s now set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Rosa. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going? Did we get many people to show up?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s going pretty well so far—folks are starting to come by, and I’m bringing a box of light bulbs for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, that’s good to hear. Need me to bring anything else besides the tape and spare screws?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yep, 3 still works for me. I’ll bring the gloves and a small flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll note 3 and keep track of the location details. Thanks for bringing the gloves and flashlight, Kira.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks. Just confirming: we’re still meeting at 3 for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks—are they all working bulbs, or should I label the box?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: If you can, please label the box—some bulbs may not be working, and that’ll help us sort them quickly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I’ll label it. Do you want me to note the bulb type too?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What needs fixing first? I can help with the tool table and any small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo—let’s start with the tool table and any small fixes you can handle first. I’ll keep track and point people to the next item after that.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I checked my toolbox, and I can bring some tape and a screwdriver, maybe a few screws too. Just let me know where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Around 3 still works for me, but could you send the exact drop-off time and a quick list of what still needs moving? If you can bring the tape and spare screws, I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure — I’ll bring the tape and spare screws and send over the exact drop-off time plus a quick list of what still needs moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still waiting on the details, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back. Thanks for being ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing—just send me the list when you get it, and I’ll jump in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do, Bo—thanks. I’m still waiting on the list, but I’ll pass it along as soon as it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still double-checking the repair drive details, but it should be on today. I’ll confirm as soon as I know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—just let me know when it’s confirmed and I can bring over a few tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll confirm the details and let you know right away if the repair drive is definitely on.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll be there at 9 to help set up the tables and sign-in sheet—what time were you thinking for the repair drive itself?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I was thinking we could start the repair drive at 10, once the tables are ready. That should give us a little time to gather any last supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—I can help get everything ready by 9 so we’re set for a 10 start.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s looking better by the hour—tools and a few cash donations have come in. I’ll keep an eye out for Manny and let you know as soon as he shows up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — that’s great news. I’ll keep the updated Sunday community center plan front and center, and let me know if Manny arrives.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll let you know right away if Manny shows up. With the tools and donations coming in, we’re in pretty good shape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still waiting on the latest repair-drive details, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. Just let me know when you get the details, and I’ll do my best to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m keeping an eye out, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the latest repair-drive update.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, we’re set for 9 AM by the community center—if you can bring work gloves and a screwdriver, that’d be awesome. Please label the box and note any bulbs that aren’t working if you can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll bring work gloves and a screwdriver, and I can label the box and note any bulbs that aren’t working.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks, Rey—see you at 9 AM by the community center.
